Name: Kenneth's Maki and Nigiri
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Maki and Nigiri[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds maki and nigiri to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Maki rolls like Salmon Roe Inside Maki Roll, Veggie Cream Maki Roll and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Nigiri sushi like various salmon and tuna nigiri slices[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Drinks like Filled Sake Wooden Cup[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Items like Empty Wooden Sake Cup, Dark Wooden Chopsticks and Light Bamboo Chopsticks[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All food items have food buffs[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Sake has a trade system that needs an empty cup[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The items are sold through my custom shops[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Japanese Restaurant[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Drink Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each shop location can be changed in GMCM and defaults to Shop1.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No recipes for now, items are sold directly in the shops. Recipes will be added in a future update.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfection Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod does not block perfection even without recipes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Japanese Restaurant[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Drink Shop (optional)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for changing shop locations[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Full requirements list is shown in the Requirements tab above.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Install all required mods listed above[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
